name: Racing marks 2026, lettered as the Cruiser Course Card's legend has them, the North Dublin Bay marks positioned by Dublin Port's Notice to Mariners 20/2026

marks.name: Churn
marks.placement: One of the club's harbour marks, west of the Bull Wall: the club's instructions list it under Harbour Marks (EC-BKC sailing instructions 12.1) and publish no position for it, and Dublin Port's notice declares only the six North Dublin Bay marks.
